title: Carry-Out Battery Return Terms by Line — Battery Replacement Warranties
content:
A battery bought at a Crestline store and carried out uninstalled is returnable for a refund on the terms below; a battery Crestline installed is not. The terms are set per line of the Battery Replacement Warranties.

| Line | Return period (calendar days after the purchase date) | Condition the battery must be in | Restocking fee (percent of the price paid) | Installed battery returnable for a refund outside a warranty claim |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Standard 24-Month Battery | 30 | unused and fully charged | 0% | No |
| Crestline Plus 30-Month Battery | 30 | unused and fully charged | 0% | No |
| Crestline Gold 36-Month Battery | 30 | unused and fully charged | 0% | No |
| Crestline AGM 36-Month Battery | 30 | unused and fully charged | 10% | No |
| Crestline Platinum AGM 48-Month Battery | 30 | unused and fully charged | 10% | No |
| Crestline Commercial Heavy-Duty 18-Month Battery | 30 | unused and fully charged | 0% | No |

**In short:** every line allows 30 calendar days and requires the battery to be unused and fully charged; the two AGM lines carry a 10% restocking fee and the four other lines carry none; and on no line is a battery Crestline installed returnable for a refund outside a warranty claim.
